title: Numerical operator synthesis without a pretrained operator or named-rule templates
predecessor_evidence: WSP-32 #922: 4583/5760 bounded in-grammar cumulative fact acquisition
WSP-33 #923: 3184/5760 unfamiliar XOR/switch; fixed-first 3304, converged shared 3508, converged source/head 3636; engineering PASS, scientific negative
question: Can a blank, rule-neutral numerical operator layer acquire the missing XOR/multiplexer structures from the same evidence without rule identity, pretrained operator weights, new source queries or gradient training?
frozen_hypothesis: A generic 3-input degree<=3 Boolean polynomial numerical circuit, with operator candidate synapses updated solely by observed source and target facts, improves accuracy by >=58 correct of the SAME 5760 WSP33 never-queried target labels over WSP33 frozen selected-two native result 3184, preserves every old target fact, and does not regress on either rule subgroup. The stronger converged control score 3636 is reported independently; not beating it bars any relative-superiority claim.

cohort.identity: Exactly the WSP33 60 source-pair x 16 completion x 2 unknown-rule worlds; 1920 worlds/5760 heldout target labels; WSP29 original actual source checkpoints verified by WSP33 loader; no subgroup removal
cohort.source_selection: Exact frozen WSP32 selected-two query/answer policy, no modifications; cold restore after each answer
cohort.unknown_rule_oracle: Only evaluator uses WSP33 XOR and switch, never learner

numerical_machine.inputs: three numerical bits (effective source0(x), effective source1(x), x[0]); source tables are WSP32 as actually acquired
numerical_machine.basis: 8 fixed Boolean monomials 1,a,b,c,ab,ac,bc,abc over GF(2), in this exact order; every coefficient vector in 0..255 is initially an eligible anonymous numerical circuit; no named XOR/switch templates
numerical_machine.plasticity: For each original observed target (not hidden targets), propagate numerical basis through each coefficient vector, multiply per-circuit eligibility by equality-to-real-target; reject contradictions; no weights trained by gradients
numerical_machine.inference: Surviving-circuit vote weighted 2^(-number-of-one-coefficients), using integer weights 2^(8-popcount); tie=>0; previously observed target bits override vote. All 256 candidates included regardless of hindsight. Operate on 3-bit binary signals with generic arithmetic; no rule label/path in learner.
numerical_machine.memory: 256 eligibility bits plus 256*8 static coefficient bits, WSP32 source+fact state; report persistent/static/program bytes and all-in time, do not claim all model synthesized

arms: selected-two unchanged WSP33 converged shared-feature trained head
selected-two numerical linear-only ablation (masks 0..15; same evidence, no extra calls)
tests: known target and original/acquired source-fact retention after cold restore
identical observed evidence => identical operator and prediction irrespective of hidden evaluator rule
negative: contradictory fact, invalid evidence and hidden target query rejected
compare all worlds, both unknown rules and representability groups, with no selective filtering

frozen_design.split: All WSP33 cases fixed in prior source, 5 known targets and 3 heldout; no fresh splits
frozen_design.data_budget: WSP33 exact 9600 source actual answers across four original arms; WSP34 observes 2 answers/world only, 3840 WSP34 model answers, no target queries
frozen_design.compute_budget: One primary full 1920-world study; 30 min hosted per OS; no model API, GPU or paid service
frozen_design.capacity: Fixed 256 candidate 8-bit coefficients + 256 eligibility bits and unchanged source memory
frozen_design.evaluator: Heldout exact correct /5760 and by-rule; previously known source/target facts must remain exact

classification_rules.supported: DEV_SUPPORTED if all custody/retention and source-budget checks pass, >=3242/5760, and neither XOR nor switch correct count below prior WSP33 selected-two subgroup (988/2880 XOR, 2196/2880 switch). Stronger trained control 3636 is separately disclosed and not called beaten unless score>=3636.
classification_rules.mixed: MIXED if engineering passes and pooled score improves but either prereg rule subgroup regresses, or pooled below 3242.
classification_rules.negative: SCIENTIFIC_NEGATIVE if engineering passes but pooled score<=3184, or pooled gain fails positive threshold; report all scores including negative ablation.
classification_rules.invalid: INVALID if protocol/source/checkpoint mismatch, oracle leak, budgets exceeded, data filtering, or retention and replay controls fail.

scientific_limits: PUBLIC DEV only. Candidate coefficient basis, selection method, WSP32 source memory, and simulator are preauthored. This is zero-gradient numerical operator inference, NOT complete-programmed general intelligence, no proof of new primitive discovery without supplied universal basis, not fully zero-training, not independent unseen-world scientific acceptance, and not matched architecture-level efficiency.
permitted: Isolated draft successor proposal; no current main, protected accepted-state, merge, promotion, integration, deployment, controller, queue, scheduler, private runner or first-use scientist gate mutation.
preregistration_note: This file committed alone before any WSP34 learner, test or primary results; negative findings must be preserved unchanged.
